verification.name: Golden Harmony render/parse fixtures.
verification.detail: The pinned official 0.0.8 package rendered the fixed system/developer/function-tool/user fixture to the exact 129-token sequence and token-CSV SHA-256 681b6d9781e15070c87ed4d468b58986f515e537c7694430fbfe6e15fa6c77f3. Strict completion parsing recovered final text, analysis-channel function calls, JSON arguments and function-call-output author mapping.

verification.name: Gateway tests.
verification.detail: Seven focused tests and all 35 repository tests passed. Non-stream and SSE Responses fixtures returned HTTP 200; SSE emitted the documented created/in_progress/item/content/delta/done/completed lifecycle with exact text reconstruction. A freshly restarted Uvicorn process also proxied live A00 health through adb forward before stopping cleanly.

metrics.adb_transport: 112193741U000563 USB; tcp:18080 forwarded to device tcp:8080

limitations: The live restart verifies gateway and device health over the actual USB forward; deterministic fixture tokens cover streaming so A01 does not repeat the already-evidenced multi-hour full Harmony prompt decode.

The shared global Python installation has unrelated dependency conflicts reported verbatim by pip check. A targeted project dependency/import check passed for openai-harmony 0.0.8, FastAPI 0.136.3 and httpx 0.28.1.
Ruff is not installed in the shared interpreter. PyCompile, a 110-column source scan, seven focused tests and all 35 repository tests passed instead.
Starlette emits a deprecation warning for its TestClient/httpx integration; this does not affect the live Uvicorn checks or test outcomes.
notes: The phone remains responsible only for bounded token inference; official Harmony rendering, channel parsing, tool formatting and Responses SSE framing stay on the laptop.
The device client sends raw comma-separated token IDs to A00, appends each deterministic result, and stops on the official Harmony stop-token set.
ADB forward tcp:18080 remains configured for A02; Uvicorn was stopped cleanly so the transport supervisor task can take ownership of port 18081.
